name: sigilbound-mobile
description: Native Android/iOS shells for the Sigilbound web game (public/game) via Capacitor.

scripts.copy-web: rm -rf www && cp -r ../public/game www && cp node_modules/@capacitor/core/dist/capacitor.js www/capacitor.js && sed -i.bak 's#<script src="native.js"></script>#<script src="capacitor.js"></script>\n  <script src="native.js"></script>#' www/index.html && rm -f www/index.html.bak
scripts.sync:android: npm run copy-web && cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run copy-web && cap sync ios
